## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `ardoq-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Generate an API token

1. Select your organization name in the top-left corner and select **Admin** > **Access control**.
2. Select **Service accounts**.
3. Select **+ Create new**.
4. <!-- manual: Give the service account a name and a token description, then confirm. Copy the generated token. -->
5. <!-- manual: If you're not using a dedicated Ardoq subdomain, also note your organization label, shown under Admin › Organization settings — the connector needs it to scope requests to your organization on the shared app.ardoq.com host. -->
